details.availability: Hosted models reached through an API; the API and documentation hosts had DNS resolution failures at review time, and pricing and sign-up paths remain unpublished.

name: Ace
notes: The Ace page describes a computer autopilot that uses the mouse and keyboard on the user's desktop, says it was trained by software specialists and domain experts on over a million tasks, and charts publisher figures for click-prediction accuracy for ace-control-medium and ace-control-small against Operator, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, UI-TARS-72B-SFT and other models, plus action latency. The About page says Ace learns from experts' screen recordings with mouse and keyboard logs, and that General Agents is developing video-language-action models. The official Python client (generalagents-python 0.1.1 at commit d36f6a8) posts a WebP screenshot, the instruction and recent actions to /v1/control/predict on api.generalagents.com; its macOS Computer class captures the screen with screencapture and performs clicks, drags, scrolls, key presses and typing through pyautogui. Apache-2.0 covers the client's code. At review time api.generalagents.com and docs.generalagents.com had DNS resolution failures; the reviewed pages leave pricing, download and sign-up paths unspecified, so current availability remains unknown.
summary: General Agents' desktop autopilot, trained on recorded expert behavior, that predicts clicks, keystrokes and other actions from screenshots; its API client ships a macOS controller that executes them.
